info.name: API Reference Accounting Codes Workflows API

params.name: callout_trigger
params.description: If set to true, the operation retrieves workflows that have the callout trigger enabled. If set to false, the operation retrieves workflows that have the callout trigger disabled. If not specified, the operation will not use this filter.

params.name: interval
params.description: A CRON expession that specifies a schedule (for example, `0 0 * * *`). If specified, the operation retrieves the workflow that is run based on the specified schedule.

params.name: name
params.description: If specified, the operation retrieves the workflow that is in the specified name.

params.name: ondemand_trigger
params.description: If set to true, the operation retrieves workflows that have the ondemand trigger enabled. If set to false, the operation retrieves workflows that have the ondemand trigger disabled. If not specified, the operation will not use this filter.

params.name: scheduled_trigger
params.description: If set to true, the operation retrieves workflows that have the scheduled trigger enabled. If set to false, the operation retrieves workflows that have the scheduled trigger disabled. If not specfied, the operation will not use this filter.

params.name: page
params.description: If you want to retrieve only the workflows on a specific page, you can specify the `page` number in the query.

params.name: page_length
params.description: The number of workflows shown in a single call. If the `page` parameter is not specified, the operation will return only the first page of results. If there are multiple pages of results, use it with the `page` parameter to get the results on subsequent pages. The maximum value is 50.

items.docs:
Run a specified workflow. In the request body, you can include parameters that you want to pass to the workflow. For the parameters to be recognized and picked up by tasks in the workflow, you need to define the parameters first.

**Note**: To run a workflow, do not use the following reserved words in the request body of the parameters.
 - `controller`
 - `action`
 - `id`
 - `user_email`
 - `user_token`
 - `format`

### User Access Permission
You must be assigned the **Workflow Run Access** perm

params.description: If specified, the operation retrieves tasks that is the specified type.

params.name: object
params.description: If specified, the operation retrieves tasks with the specified object.

params.name: object_id
params.description: If specified, the operation retrieves tasks with the specified object id.

params.name: call_type
params.description: If specified, the operation retrieves tasks with the specified api call type used.

params.name: workflow_id
params.description: If specified, the operation retrieves tasks that for the specified workflow id.

params.name: tags
params.description:
If specified, the operation retrieves tasks that with the specified filter tags. Use the following syntax to specify multiple tags: `tags[]=tag_value_1&tags[]=tag_value_2`.

**Note:** All the workflow tasks that have any of the specified tags will be listed in the response body.

params.name: page
params.description: If you want to retrieve only the workflows on a specific page, you can specify the `page` number in the query.

params.name: page_length
params.description: The number of workflow tasks shown in a single call. If the `page` parameter is not specified, the operation will return only the first page of results. If there are multiple pages of results, use it with the `page` parameter to get the results on subsequent pages. The maximum value is 100.
